name: London Borough of Camden

departments.name: Licensing
departments.notes: Handles Licensing Act 2003 and Gambling Act 2005 applications. 28-day public consultation period. Pre-application advice service available. Appointments available Mon-Fri 9am-5pm at 5 Pancras Square. Statement of Licensing Policy 2025-2030 in effect until 30 January 2027.

departments.name: Street Trading
departments.notes: Operates 8 council-run street markets and 48 miscellaneous trading sites. Annual and casual licences available. Licensed under London Local Authorities Act 1990 (as amended). Does not operate private markets such as Camden Lock. Quarterly Markets Newsletter available via email subscription.

departments.name: Planning
departments.notes: Applications submitted via national Planning Portal. Development Management handles planning permission, listed building consent, advertisement display, and provides information/advice service.

departments.name: Building Control
departments.notes: Ensures building work meets Building Regulations requirements including structural safety, fire safety, thermal/sound insulation, drainage, and disabled access. Also handles reports of dangerous structures.

departments.name: Highways
departments.notes: Traffic Engineering handles road safety schemes, parking management, disabled bays, CPZs. Streetworks Team coordinates road/street works, crane operations, and road closures. Recently advertised proposals viewable online with public comment facility.

departments.name: Environmental Health
departments.notes: Noise complaints email is noiseteam@camden.gov.uk for case updates. Online reporting requires Camden Account registration. Personal details kept confidential from businesses when making complaints. Responsible authority for licensing consultations.

departments.name: HMO Licensing

address.line1: Private Sector Housing HMO Licensing Team

departments.notes: Borough-wide additional HMO licensing scheme started 8 December 2025, runs until December 2030. Criminal offence to operate licensable HMO without licence. Queries about licensing requirements, application process, and form issues handled by this team.

departments.name: Trading Standards
departments.notes: Consumer advice provided via Citizens Advice Consumer Service (government-funded partnership). Trading Standards provides advice to Camden-based businesses and new businesses setting up in Camden. Appointments available Mon-Fri 9am-5pm.

responsibleAuthorities.notes: Responsible authorities include Police, Fire Brigade, and council teams (Community Safety). Tasking Group meets fortnightly to monitor licensing intelligence. Partnership protocol emphasizes coordinated, intelligence-led approach for evening/night-time economy.

researchNotes: Research conducted via Camden Council website and public search results. Council headquarters at 5 Pancras Square, Kings Cross. Licensing email confirmed as licensing@camden.gov.uk. Statement of Licensing Policy 2025-2030 in effect. HMO additional licensing scheme renewed December 2025 for 5 years. Taxi/private hire licensing handled by Transport for London, not Camden Council directly.
